title: Check each term
text: [$$vt**{2}$$]=$$LT**{-1}$$*$$T**{2}$$=LT. [at]=$$LT**{-2}$$*T=$$LT**{-1}$$. Neither term has dimensions L, and the two terms don't even match each other.

title: Conclusion
text: Since the right-hand side terms have dimensions LT and $$LT**{-1}$$ - neither equal to $$[s]=L$$ - this equation is not dimensionally consistent.
